**Cycle 4 QA verification (independent live-DOM)**:

- Static grep verification confirms dev report claims:
  - `knownTools.tsx:755-757` — `CodexPatch.extractSubtitle` returns `null` (AC1).
  - `knownTools.tsx:1398/1421/1437/1453` — four new Playwright entries present (AC2).

  - `CodexAttachmentView.tsx:37` no longer contains `'Preview unavailable'` literal; uses `t('tools.attachment.staleAdvisory')` (AC4).
  - `en.ts:574` and `_default.ts:558` — `staleAdvisory` value is `'Trigger again in this or a new session to view the inline preview.'` containing both `new session` AND `inline preview` (AC4).
  - Fixture row `pty-write-stdin` description (line 691): `'PTY streaming behavior is observable only on real Codex sessions — fixture is static by design.'` contains both `static fixture` AND `streaming` (AC5).
  - Fixture row `request-user-input-unavailable` description (line 557): `'Default-mode limitation rendered as unavailable. Plan mode availability is a Codex CLI concern outside the Happy frontend.'` contains both `Plan mode` AND (`CLI` OR `outside`) (AC6).
- Test verification: `yarn vitest run codexToolRendering.test.ts` — 10/10 pass (361ms). Reproduces dev report claim.
- Live DOM probe (independent run via `node scripts/cycle-4-dom-probe.js`):
  - Desktop 1440x900: AC1 examplesCount=1 / editCount=1 / AC2 dataPresent=true longSuffixAbsent=true / AC3 tokyo+aapl+nba+lakers all true / AC4 newSession+inlinePreview both true.
  - Mobile 390x844: identical results — all probes pass.
- Independent Playwright MCP DOM probe (cross-check):
  - Desktop: example.ts count=1 (AC1 dedup confirmed); 'data:' present + long HTML suffix absent (AC2 truncation confirmed); Asia/Tokyo+AAPL+NBA+Lakers all rendered (AC3); 'Trigger again' + 'new session' + 'inline preview' all rendered, 'Preview unavailable' literal NOT in DOM (AC4 advisory replacement confirmed).
  - Mobile 390x844: identical results.
- Spec sections 2/3/4 cycle-4 sub-sections present and additive (Cycles 1/2/3 untouched).
- Cycle-4 scope — 14 in-scope source/test/fixture/i18n files + 1 test-helper script (`scripts/cycle-4-dom-probe.js`) + 2 screenshot artifacts. Test-helper script is a verification artifact (BA ticket allowed verification deliverables); flagged but not blocking.
- Safety: Playwright navigated only to `http://localhost:8097`; no production access; no daemon restart; no `npm install -g`.
